show.description: Lakshya Oberoi—India’s youngest billionaire—was never meant to be anyone’s husband. But a one-night stand with fiery Tanya Goenka traps him in a dangerous contract marriage built on lies, lust, and survival. As Tanya battles her scheming stepmother, jealous stepsister and ruthless ex-fiancé, secrets unravel and enemies close in. In a world of stolen identities and deadly conspiracies, Lakshya must decide if Tanya is his greatest weakness—or the only ally who can save him.
